summary: Frontend-only i18n verification (Task P1) for the 8 newly-translated dynamic screens: assistant, ndis-codes, reports, templates, shift, invoice/[id], invoice/new, client/[id]. Static-key validation: parsed every t('ns.key') literal from the 8 tsx files (194 unique keys total) and confirmed 100% presence in en.json (559 total keys). Dynamic template-string keys also verified: templates.tsx uses t(`templates.${tk}Title|Desc`) with tk in {invoice,report,expense} → all 6 keys exist; client/[id].tsx uses t(`clientDetail.${dk}`) with dk in {docServiceAgreement,docConsent,docPlan,docDocument} → all 4 keys exist. Runtime browser test on public Expo web preview at 390x844, logged in as TEST_USER_EMAIL (has clients, invoices and an active shift). Visited every in-scope screen and ran a regex leak-scan '(assistant|ndisCodes|reports|templates|shift|invoiceDetail|invoiceNew|clientDetail)\.[a-zA-Z0-9_]+' against document.body.innerText — ZERO unresolved i18n key literals on any screen or modal. Every requested testID resolved (assistant-screen/input/send + shuffle-suggestions; ndis-codes-screen + ndis-search + 18 tag-* chips + 25 add-* buttons; reports-screen + fy-prev/next + export-invoices/receipts; templates-screen + template-invoice/report + generate-report-btn; shift-screen + end-shift-btn + draft-* rows [drew is on an active shift so start-shift-btn/shiftclient-* only render in idle state — verified via code]; invoice-detail-screen + preview-invoice-btn + toggle-paid-btn + share-invoice-btn + edit-invoice-btn + duplicate-invoice-btn; invoice/new: generate-invoice-btn + compliance-panel + add-item-btn + ndis-code-btn-0 + link-client-btn + code-search + client picker modal; client-detail-screen + save-notes-btn + add-reminder-btn + add-doc-btn + save-reminder-btn + save-doc-btn). English keywords verified: 'Code Assistant', 'NDIS Support Codes / Up to date', 'Reports & BAS / Income (paid) / Expenses / Net position / Income vs Expenses / BAS · GST Summary', 'Templates / NDIS Tax Invoice / Progress Report / Expense Summary / PDF / Word', 'Active Shift / Draft Invoices / Shift Receipts / End Shift', 'PAID / BILL TO / Line Items / Subtotal / GST (10%) / Total / Preview / Unpaid / Send', 'New Invoice / Compliance 1/6 — complete the red items / Client / Participant / NDIS Participant Number / Link Client', 'Billed / Paid / Pending / Important Notes / Save Notes / Reminders / Documents / Planned Tasks / Invoices / Add Document / Service Agreement / Consent / Plan / Document / Photo / Upload / Save Document'. Assistant AI end-to-end: typed 'community access' → send → reply 'Community access support depends on day of the week and timing...' rendered with follow-up suggestion chips. No red-screen errors, no runtime crashes, no unresolved key leaks anywhere.

Cosmetic RN-web warning, no visual/functional impact. Likely a stray whitespace text node in a <View> in client/[id].tsx (candidate: whitespace between adjacent <> siblings in the Care Profile / Reminders sections).
Persistent RN-web deprecation warnings (carried over from iteration 18) still logged on every navigation. Cosmetic only. Reference: theme/global stylesheets.

critical_code_review_comments: All 194 static t('ns.key') references across the 8 in-scope files resolve to a real entry in en.json — no missing keys. Dynamic template-string usages (templates tk-suffix, clientDetail doc-type chips) are safe because every constant array value in the source has a matching en.json entry.

Interpolation keys look correctly wired: clientDetail.left/{{amount}} for budget remaining, clientDetail.deleteMsg/{{name}}, clientDetail.reminderNotifTitle uses {{name}}, invoiceDetail.due/{{date}}, invoiceDetail.issued/{{date}} etc. All present in en.json.
assistant.tsx: send flow correctly transitions message list -> 'Finding the right code…' -> AI reply, no hard-coded English literals left in the rendered UI.

shift.tsx: idle-state UI (start-shift-btn + shiftclient-* rows) could not be runtime-verified because drew has an active shift (expected per handoff). Static-key coverage confirms English strings for the idle state are present in en.json.
invoice/new.tsx (496 lines) and client/[id].tsx (521 lines) are approaching the 700-line threshold in the code-review guidelines — not urgent but worth watching.
